chunks: Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله with an uqiyyah of camphor from Paradise, and the uqiyyah is forty dirhams. Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله made it into three portions: one third for himself, one third for ʿAlī عليه السلام, and one third for Fāṭimah عليها السلام.

key_terms.أُوقِيَّةِ: an uqiyyah, a unit of weight
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the heavenly source of the camphor
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلَ: Jibrāʾīl, the angelic messenger who brought the gift
key_terms.دِرْهَمًا: dirham, the unit used to clarify the weight
key_terms.كَافُورٍ: camphor used here as a fragrant substance from Paradise

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith about camphor from Paradise given to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and shared with ʿAlī and Fāṭimah عليهم السلام mean?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام brought camphor from Paradise to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, who then divided it into three equal shares. The report highlights the special rank of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, and Fāṭimah عليها السلام, and appears in the context of funerary preparation.
